paper_title: Constraining the axion-photon coupling using radio data of the Bullet Cluster
notes: Headline curve is the two-component model (cosmic-ray + axion decay) 2-sigma upper limit on g_agamma, tabulated in Table 2 and shown as the blue SOLID step line in Fig. 1. Six mass sub-bands (14-17,17-20,20-23,23-26,26-29,29-32 microeV) with upper limits 3.4e-11, 9.0e-12, 3.8e-12, 4.6e-12, 9.6e-12, 1.3e-11 GeV^-1 respectively; emitted as a step function over the sub-band mass edges. This is the paper's tighter/more realistic limit (reaching ~10^-12-10^-11 GeV^-1) that includes cosmic-ray synchrotron background, as opposed to the more conservative all-flux-from-axion limit (blue dashed line, ~2.3-5.3e-11 GeV^-1). The paper uses the CAST/standard g_agamma convention (L = -(g/4) a F Ftilde), so no conversion needed. Limit depends on the Bullet cluster virial mass M = 3.1e15 Msun (NFW profile), not on a local DM density, so dm_density_assumed is null. Upper limits are quoted as 'ruled out at 2 sigma' -> confidence_level 0.95.
